name: The enforcement
owner: whoever set the control: the vendor, the platform, the deployer or nobody
smallest: one configuration line at one layer, set by one party, on one date
status_note: Four barriers, three enforcers, one Control formula that the gate walks on every build. The formula is the most important thing on the site and it lands in a world with three nodes. The dev brief of 11 September on the prohibition's two lives wrote most of this universe's vocabulary and it was never made into nodes.

node_types.name: Barrier
node_types.formula: [Barrier] := a node that -bounds-> at least one [GrantedCapability]

node_types.name: Enforcer
node_types.formula: a node that -enforces-> at least one [Barrier], -set_by-> a [Party], -at_layer-> a [Layer]
node_types.note: Three today, with only inside_the_grant on each. Party and Layer are the change.

node_types.name: Control
node_types.formula: [Control] := a [Barrier] that is -enforced_by-> an [Enforcer] the [Grant] does not include
node_types.note: Does not change, and gains a second reading: with Party and removable_by as nodes and edges, does not include becomes a path, walked one universe further.

node_types.name: Layer
node_types.formula: one of prompt, tool schema, client rule, gateway, sandbox; a node a [Layer] is -above-> or -below-> another

node_types.name: Party
node_types.formula: the vendor, the platform, the deployer, the administrator, the agent's own account, or nobody

node_types.name: EvidencedControl
node_types.formula: a [Control] whose [Enforcer] is -backed_by-> an [Observation] in U3
node_types.note: The regulated customer's stricter formula from the three layers page, now writable beside ours without touching ours.

node_types.name: CompiledRule
node_types.formula: a node that a [Prohibition] in U7 -compiles_to->, in a named target language, that -passes-> a shadowed permit analysis

verbs.reads_as: this barrier is enforced by something above the grant
this enforcer was set by this party
this enforcer sits at the gateway layer
verbs.inverse_reads_as: the gateway layer is the layer of these enforcers

verbs.reads_as: this enforcer can be removed by this party
verbs.inverse_reads_as: this party can remove these enforcers
verbs.from: proposed here; the enforcer test as an edge

verbs.reads_as: this enforcer is good until this date, or has no stated expiry
verbs.inverse_reads_as: this date is the expiry of these enforcers

verbs.reads_as: this prohibition compiles to this rule
verbs.inverse_reads_as: this rule is compiled from this prohibition

verbs.reads_as: this barrier was defeated in this observation

adds: Lab 06 added the property the 11 September brief did not have: a barrier is perishable, and a classifier that refuses a probe today is a barrier with no row and no expiry. The five layers become nodes so that the leaflet's rightmost column, the layer a control would sit at, stops being a string.

provenance.note: The universe is authored in admin/build/universes.py; the matched counts and the live junctions are computed from the graph on every build.
